name: checkout-stress-open
description: Open-loop chain-amplification workload. Each logical request is a 2-step workflow: POST /cart (populate the session's cart) followed by POST /cart/checkout (place the order). The checkout call fans out from frontend → checkout → {cart, productcatalog, currency, payment, shipping, email}, exercising the deepest HTTP/gRPC chain in Online Boutique. Used for chain-amplification experiments where the fault sits on a deep leaf service (typically paymentservice).
